description: Render the timeline to a file, at the sequence size and frame rate. Formats: mp4_h264 (MP4), mp4_h264_fast (MP4, quick and small with sound, to watch a cut), mp4_av1 (MP4, AV1/Opus), mov_prores_422hq (MOV), gif (15 fps), wav, mp3. overrides sets another size (a box, aspect kept), fps, bitrate or crf (video://catalog/presets). Scaling up adds no detail: a picture made larger than its source looks soft. Long-running: returns a task, or {job_id} for job.get. The result links the file (a resource_link to video://jobs/{job_id}/output, which reads as the file, or its signed URL when large), has a signed download URL and a page_url that plays it in any browser (the link to give a person to watch or share), both working for 168 h (job.get gives fresh ones). The file itself is deleted 7 days after the export finishes (kept_until, and expiry in words): save it from url to keep it. A picture export (video, GIF) downloads with a cuttingfloor watermark, for reviewing, which is free, until it is released (export.release, 1 credit a finished minute); the result says when it has one, the price and the user's credits. The server keeps the file 7 days, as a working copy: when the user has a finished piece to keep, offer to save it from the url where they keep their files, and media.import it to use it again. qa.check measures a render (gaps, frames, loudness) before you export. sha256 and fingerprint tell two renders apart without downloading them (fingerprint matches media.get of the file once imported).

filename.description: Output file name without extension. Default: timeline name and id

overrides.description: Change the preset: a size box (aspect kept), frame rate, bitrate or quality

bitrate.description: Video bitrate like 8M, instead of constant quality

preset.description: A format; the picture comes out at the sequence size unless overrides set another. video://catalog/presets lists what each takes

timeline_id.description: Timeline handle; every edit returns a new one

name: export.video

job_id.description: Job handle; the same value is the MCP task id

media_id.description: The media it is making: an import is usable in edits once its status is processing, a created media once this job completes

result.description: The result, when status is completed; otherwise job.get gives it once completed

credits_left.description: While watermarked, the user's credits now; null when the account has no credit cap

expiry.description: kept_until in words: how long is left, and what keeps it longer or how to keep it

file.description: Where the file was written in the exports folder (local mode)

fingerprint.description: The fingerprint media.get gives the file once imported

kept_until.description: When the server deletes it: 7 days after the export finished

page_url.description: A page that plays the file in any browser, with no sign-in: the link to give a person to watch or share it. Works until expires_at

release_credits.description: What removing the watermark costs, in credits: 1 a finished minute, in quarter-minute steps

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the whole file: equal only for equal bytes

watermark_note.description: While watermarked, the watermark, its removal price and what the user has, in words

watermarked.description: True: the file downloads with a cuttingfloor watermark; export.release removes the watermark for release_credits, after which every link to it serves the clean file. Absent or false: the file is clean

title: Export video
